title: Figures 101-102: Cylinder CFD pressure and temperature at 500 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of a flat-ended cylinder at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 101. Cylinder Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 500 mph with Mixed Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (pressure peak at the front face, in Pa) and "Figure 102. Cylinder Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 500 mph with Mixed Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (hot wake band, in K). Attachment III, page 134 of the BAASS report.
